label: prf:categorical-action-exists
title: Proof of existence of the categorical action
html:
Proof. Proof of existence of the categorical action

The rigid structure of \mathbf{C} supplies the evaluation and coevaluation morphisms \mathrm{ev}_A \colon A^\vee \otimes A \to \mathbf{1} and \mathrm{coev}_A \colon \mathbf{1} \to A \otimes A^\vee (rigid monoidal category). The tensor \mathrm{id}_{A^\vee} \otimes \Phi is a morphism by functoriality. The three-fold composition

  \mathbf{1}
  \xrightarrow{\mathrm{coev}_A}
  A \otimes A^\vee
  \xrightarrow{\Phi \otimes \mathrm{id}}
  A \otimes A^\vee
  \xrightarrow{\mathrm{ev}_A}
  \mathbf{1}

is therefore a morphism \mathbf{1} \to \mathbf{1}. The equality with the categorical trace follows from the definition of \mathrm{tr}(\Phi) via the rigid structure.
